specificity_pocket_completeness_check: Trp812 and Val882 -- the exact residues diagnosed as the cause of 6AUD's Gate-1 failure -- verified fully modeled, full-occupancy in 6XRL (absent from both REMARK 465 and REMARK 480 in the raw deposited PDB).

hinge_hbond_recovery.checked_residue: Val882 (Gate-0-verified hinge anchor: delta Val828 -> alpha Val851 -> gamma Val882)
hinge_hbond_recovery.result: Recovered in all 4 passing seeds (1,2,4,5), consistent donor role (Val882 backbone N-H to ligand), distances 2.90-3.32 A -- genuine ATP-competitive hinge chemistry, not merely a coincidental RMSD pass.

decision_matrix_outcome: Gamma PASS (per the mandate decision matrix): the alternative experimental structure (6XRL) achieves the Gate-1 criterion (4/5 <=2.0A) with chemically valid RMSD and the conserved hinge interaction is recovered. Interpretation: the original 6AUD failure is most consistent with receptor-structure-specific limitations (confirmed: Trp812/Val882 incompleteness in 6AUD specifically) rather than a general inability of the docking protocol to reproduce PI3Kgamma binding. Per the instruction to find an adequate experimental structure before considering modeled completion: one was found and validated -- modeled completion is not needed for gamma at this time.
standing_status_update: This validates 6XRL as a Gate-1-PASSING gamma receptor. It does NOT retroactively revalidate any already-committed analysis that used 6AUD (Gate 3, Representation 2/3, geometry ladder) -- those results stand as computed, with the gamma Gate-1-FAIL caveat that was already attached to them at the time. Re-running production docking/representation work against 6XRL instead of 6AUD is the natural next step for any FUTURE gamma-involving analysis, but is a separate, not-yet-executed task, explicitly deferred here rather than folded into this validation.
